name: Bolt w/ Nut 20 x 102 x 10" HR
description: The Nirmal NIRMAL/UB/372AB Bolt w/ Nut 20 x 102 x 10" HR clamps a vehicle axle or associated component to the leaf-spring pack or mounting structure. Vehicle applications include Ashok Leyland U Truck.
applications: Vehicle fitment evidence (Nirmal Price List No. 67/2026, p. 8; exact part-number match): Leyland U-Truck 2528 and 4923, truck/trailer front or rear U-bolt application.
hsn_description: Other screws and bolts, whether or not with their nuts or washers, of iron or steel
hsn_basis: The product is identified as a vehicle bolt/fastener.
hsn_review_note: Confirm iron/steel construction and that the kit is principally bolts/fasteners.
weight_estimation_method: Estimated steel U-bolt mass: theoretical solid steel rod at 7,850 kg/m³ using centreline length = 2 × nominal leg length + π × (inside width + rod diameter) / 2, plus two estimated hex nuts (M20 60.5 g each; M22 85 g each). Nominal inch leg length is converted using the existing Nirmal catalogue model convention of 25 mm per inch. Packed checkout weight adds 5% and rounds up to the next 50 g.
weight_estimation_notes: Calculated estimate only; not manufacturer-weighed. U-bolt profile, end threads, bends, plating, exact nut grade/geometry and actual leg length can change mass. Confirm with a physical sample before treating as a net weight. Product dimensions are component geometry, not packed-carton dimensions.
